extracted.intended_audience: researchers and research offices seeking Wellcome grant funding (all career stages)
extracted.subtask_description: Institutional guidance describing Wellcome's funding schemes, thematic remits, career-stage eligibility, application and grant-management processes for researchers and organisations seeking Wellcome support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fund research addressing life, health and wellbeing
rubrics_metrics.description: We fund researchers to take on important questions relating to life, health, and wellbeing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Wellcome plans to spend £16 billion by 2032 to advance scientific discovery and take on urgent health issues; proposals should address important questions in these areas.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support creative approaches that push boundaries
rubrics_metrics.description: We fund researchers with creative approaches that push boundaries.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Wellcome emphasises support for ideas that are novel and ambitious; applicants should present approaches that move beyond incremental work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Promote collaboration and inclusive research culture
rubrics_metrics.description: Ground‑breaking discoveries are more likely to occur in collaborations between a diverse range of people, so we are working with partners and the teams we fund to support a thriving, inclusive research culture.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Wellcome expects and supports collaborative, diverse teams and partnerships as part of project design and execution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scheme eligibility aligned to career stage
rubrics_metrics.description: Each scheme is designed to target a different career stage, but all are open to the best ideas across a huge remit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should select the scheme appropriate to their career stage (early, mid, established) and ensure their proposal fits that scheme's aims and eligibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Wellcome Early-Career Awards – establish independence and trajectory
rubrics_metrics.description: This award supports researchers to establish their independence and trajectory in discovery research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Early-career applicants should demonstrate emerging independence and a plan for career trajectory within discovery research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Wellcome Career Development Awards – mid-career leadership and international standing
rubrics_metrics.description: For mid-career researchers who are ready to lead a substantial, innovative research programme and achieve international standing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mid-career applicants should show readiness to lead significant programmes and an ambition/plan to attain international recognition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Wellcome Discovery Awards – support for established researchers and teams
rubrics_metrics.description: This award supports established researchers and teams.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Established investigators and team leaders should propose substantial discovery research projects appropriate to their experience and track record.

rubrics_metrics.name: Open remit across many disciplines
rubrics_metrics.description: Wellcome funds discovery research in and across physical, social, data and life sciences, the humanities and clinical research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals from a broad range of disciplines are eligible; applicants should make clear how their work contributes to life, health, or wellbeing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Thematic remit alignment (mental health, infectious disease, climate & health)
rubrics_metrics.description: We also offer specific funding opportunities to support our work in mental health, infectious disease, and climate and health.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants targeting these themes should consult the detailed remit and funding opportunities pages for what projects Wellcome will and won’t fund (e.g., mental health remit page; infectious disease and climate & health remits noted as coming soon).

rubrics_metrics.name: Adhere to published scheme deadlines
rubrics_metrics.description: See a list of our scheme deadlines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must observe the published deadlines for each scheme when preparing submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow Wellcome’s application and grant‑management guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: We have detailed funding guidance on exactly how to apply for funding, manage funding and more.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants and grant-holders should consult guidance topics including Applying for funding, Starting a grant, Ending a grant, Research outputs, Information for Research offices, Grant finance and administration, Research practice and policies; use the Grant Tracker platform to apply/manage grants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Organisations may apply for contract opportunities
rubrics_metrics.description: We also invite organisations to apply for contract opportunities that support our mission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Beyond grants to researchers, organisations can pursue contract funding; check relevant procurement/contract notices for details and requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transparency about funded awards and data
rubrics_metrics.description: Find out about the people and projects we've funded, including grants awarded, researcher stories and grant funding data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Wellcome provides information on awarded grants and funding data for applicants to review prior awards and understand funding patterns and outcomes.
